data.title: mobilezone enables smartphone purchases through Mia chat
data.description:
mobilezone holding AG ( (CH:MOZN) ) has issued an announcement.

mobilezone holding ag operates in Switzerland’s telecommunications and mobile lifestyle products market, serving private and business customers. Its offering includes mobile phones, mobile and fixed-line tariffs, digital TV and internet, accessories, mobile virtual network services, B2B services, repairs and refurbished devices through retail and e-commerce channels.

The company says it is the first in Switzerland’s smartphone and mobile communications market to combine consultation, product selection, checkout and payment in one dialogue. Its AI assistant Mia now lets customers choose products, add them to a cart and pay by TWINT or credit card within the chat, making the feature available on mobilezone.ch across devices.

data.title: AXIA Energia Announces Agreements to Unwind Transmission Cross-Shareholdings
data.description:
Centrais Eletricas Brasileiras SA-Eletrobras ( (BR:AXIA3) ) just unveiled an announcement.

AXIA Energia, through subsidiaries AXIA Energia Norte and AXIA Energia Nordeste, signed share purchase agreements with Alupar to unwind cross-shareholdings in transmission companies TNE and STN. The agreements provide for Nordeste’s sale of its 49% STN stake, Norte’s acquisition of Alupar’s 35% TNE stake and a cash payment of R$367.1 million.

Completion remains subject to customary market conditions and adjustments. Following completion, AXIA Energia would consolidate 100% of TNE, whose Manaus–Boa Vista line has connected Roraima to the National Interconnected System since September 2025; the company said the transaction reinforces its commitment to optimizing minority interests, maintaining capital allocation discipline and simplifying its structure.

data.title: Hwacom Explains Q3 2026 Related-Party Transaction Amount Differences
data.description:
Hwacom Systems Inc ( (TW:6163) ) has shared an update.

Hwacom Systems Inc. disclosed that the difference between its reported and auditor-verified related-party transaction amounts for Q3 2026 exceeded 20% and NT$10 million. The discrepancy arose after the company acquired 4,250 thousand shares of subsidiary SUREWIN CO., LTD. from Le-Yi Investment Holding CO., LTD. at NT$10 per share, for a total of NT$42,500 thousand, and confirmed Le-Yi was also a related party; Hwacom adjusted the filing information, fully disclosed the matter in its financial statement notes, and reported it through the Market Observation Post System and a material information announcement.
